text: Paribasan Jawa sing ngélingaké supaya ora kesusu muni: “Alon-alon waton …”. Tembung pungkasané apa?
gloss: A Javanese saying warning against haste: 'Slowly, as long as…'. What is the last word? — Kelakon ('it gets done'): 'alon-alon waton kelakon'.

text: Rara lair ing wulan Januari 2000. Ing wulan Désèmber 2025, umuré wis pira?
gloss: Rara was born in January 2000. How old is she in December 2025? — Selawé (25): Javanese has its own word for 25 instead of the regular 'limang likur'; selikur is 21.

text: Laba-laba kerep dikira serangga, padhahal dudu. Sikilé laba-laba ana pira?
gloss: Spiders are often taken for insects, but they aren't. How many legs does a spider have? — Eight (wolu); six is the insect trap.

text: Ing pagelaran wayang kulit sewengi natas, sapa sing nglakokaké wayang lan nyuwaraké kabèh paragané?
gloss: In an all-night shadow-puppet show, who moves the puppets and voices every character? — The dhalang. Sindhèn and waranggana are female singers, niyaga the gamelan players.

text: Gudheg, panganan khas Yogyakarta sing legi lan coklat, digawé saka apa?
gloss: Gudeg, Yogyakarta's sweet brown dish, is made from what? — Young jackfruit (nangka enom, gori). Bamboo shoot (rebung) is the lumpia filling.

text: Saben taun mayuta-yuta wong Islam saka sakdonya ngubengi Ka'bah nalika ibadah haji. Ka'bah dumunung ing kutha endi?
gloss: Every year millions of Muslims circle the Kaaba during the hajj. Which city is it in? — Mecca; Medina, the Prophet's city, is the near trap.

text: Bu Narti tuku tempé telung papan, regané Rp3.000 saben papan. Dhèwèké mbayar nganggo dhuwit Rp10.000. Susuké pira?
gloss: Bu Narti buys three blocks of tempeh at Rp3,000 each and pays with Rp10,000. Her change? — Rp1,000: 3 × 3,000 = 9,000; Rp7,000 is the change for one block.

text: Terusna urutan iki: 3, 6, 12, 24, … Angka sabanjuré pira?
gloss: Continue: 3, 6, 12, 24, … — 48: each number doubles. 30 and 36 are the traps of adding 6 or 12.

text: Ing liga bal-balan, menang olèh 3 poin, imbang olèh 1, kalah olèh 0. Sawijining tim menang ping loro, imbang sapisan lan kalah sapisan. Poiné pira?
gloss: In a football league a win is 3 points, a draw 1, a loss 0. A team wins twice, draws once and loses once. Points? — 7: 3 + 3 + 1 + 0.

text: Menara lonceng sing misuwur amarga miring dumunung ing kutha Pisa. Kutha iku ana ing negara endi?
gloss: The bell tower famous for leaning is in Pisa. Which country is Pisa in? — Italy.

text: Yèn ngaturi simbah mangan, wong Jawa ora ngucap “mangan”, nanging nganggo tembung krama inggil. Tembung apa?
gloss: Inviting a grandparent to eat, a Javanese speaker doesn't say 'mangan' but uses the high honorific (krama inggil). Which word? — Dhahar. Nedha is plain krama, used of oneself; sare is 'sleep', unjuk 'drink'.

text: Kali paling dawa ing pulo Jawa iki tuwuh ing Wonogiri, Jawa Tengah, lan muara ing Gresik, Jawa Timur. Kali apa?
gloss: Java's longest river rises in Wonogiri, Central Java, and reaches the sea at Gresik, East Java. Which? — Bengawan Solo. The Brantas, second longest, lies wholly in East Java.

text: Gamelan Jawa nduwé rong laras utawa tangga nada. Siji pélog, sijiné manèh apa?
gloss: Javanese gamelan has two tunings: pélog and which other? — Sléndro. Madenda and degung are Sundanese tunings, salisir a Balinese one.

text: Godhong ijo ngolah panganan nganggo sinar srengéngé. Gas apa sing diserep saka hawa kanggo proses kuwi?
gloss: Green leaves make food from sunlight. Which gas do they take from the air for it? — Carbon dioxide; oxygen is what they give off.

text: Kanca janjian ketemu “jam setengah sanga ésuk”. Ing jam digital, iku jam pira?
gloss: A friend agrees to meet at 'half nine in the morning' in Javanese. What time is that on a digital clock? — 08.30: Javanese counts the half hour towards the coming hour ('half to nine'); 09.30 is the English-style trap.

text: Ing kandhang ana pitik lan wedhus. Gunggungé sirah ana lima, gunggungé sikil ana patbelas. Wedhusé ana pira?
gloss: A pen holds chickens and goats: five heads, fourteen legs. How many goats? — Two: 2 goats × 4 + 3 chickens × 2 = 14.

text: Kimchi, sawi sing difermentasi nganggo lombok lan bawang, iku panganan khas negara endi?
gloss: Kimchi, cabbage fermented with chilli and garlic, is the signature dish of which country? — Korea (both Koreas, hence no 'South').

text: Ing basa Jawa, anaké anak diarani putu, anaké putu diarani buyut, anaké buyut diarani canggah. Bu Sri iku canggahé Mbah Karto. Yèn saben generasi kira-kira 25 taun, Mbah Karto luwih tuwa kira-kira pira?
gloss: In Javanese a child's child is putu, a putu's child buyut, a buyut's child canggah. Bu Sri is Mbah Karto's canggah. At about 25 years a generation, how much older is he? — About 100 years: child, grandchild, great-grandchild, great-great-grandchild = 4 generations. 75 is the trap of counting the three named words.

text: Serial animasi bocah kembar gundhul Upin lan Ipin digawé ing negara endi?
gloss: The cartoon about the bald twins Upin and Ipin is made in which country? — Malaysia (Les' Copaque Production).

text: Sepur budhal saka Yogyakarta jam 21.45 lan lakuné 8 jam 30 menit. Jam pira sepur iku tekan Jakarta?
gloss: A train leaves Yogyakarta at 21.45 and travels 8 h 30 min. When does it reach Jakarta? — 06.15 the next morning.

text: Marco Polo, sing lelungan nganti tekan kratoné Kubilai Khan ing Tiongkok, iku saudagar asal kutha endi?
gloss: Marco Polo, who travelled to Kublai Khan's court in China, was a merchant from which city? — Venice. Genoa is the trap: he dictated his book while a prisoner there.

text: Astronot sing massané 70 kg ing Bumi mabur menyang Rembulan. Ing kana, massané dadi pira?
gloss: An astronaut with a mass of 70 kg on Earth flies to the Moon. What is his mass there? — Still 70 kg: mass doesn't change; only weight drops to about a sixth (the 12 kg trap).

text: Miturut legendha asal-usulé aksara Jawa, Aji Saka nduwé abdi loro sing padha setya marang dhawuhé nganti tarung lan mati bebarengan. Sapa abdi loro mau?
gloss: In the legend of the Javanese script, Aji Saka had two servants so loyal to his orders that they fought and died together. Who? — Dora and Sembada. The others are other famous servant pairs: Pandawa clowns, Brawijaya's legendary servants, Panji's clowns.

text: Weton, gabungan dina lan pasaran kaya Setu Pahing utawa Jemuwah Kliwon, baleni manèh saben pirang dina?
gloss: A weton, the pairing of weekday and market day such as Saturday Pahing, repeats every how many days? — 35 (selapan): 7 weekdays × 5 market days; 12 is the trap of adding.

text: Kali Amazon, kali sing banyuné paling akèh ing donya, muara ing samodra endi?
gloss: The Amazon, the river with the most water in the world, flows into which ocean? — The Atlantic, although it rises in the Andes near the Pacific.

text: Lampu 10 watt diurubaké suwéné 10 jam. Pira listrik sing dientèkaké?
gloss: A 10-watt lamp burns for 10 hours. How much electricity does it use? — 0.1 kWh: 100 watt-hours, and a kilowatt-hour is 1,000 watt-hours.

text: Gudèl iku anaké kebo. Paribasan “kebo nusu gudèl” kanggo nggambaraké apa?
options: Wong tuwa sinau marang wong enom
Anak sing ora bekti marang wong tuwané
gloss: A gudèl is a buffalo calf. What does the saying 'the buffalo suckles from its calf' describe? — An elder learning from someone younger.

text: Ing alam liar, kéwan iki saiki mung kari ana ing Taman Nasional Ujung Kulon, ing pucuk kulon pulo Jawa. Kéwan apa?
gloss: In the wild this animal now survives only in Ujung Kulon National Park, at Java's western tip. Which? — The Javan rhino. Banteng, Javan gibbon and Javan leopard also live elsewhere in Java.

text: Kodhe QR kerep dipindai nganggo hapé kanggo mbayar. “QR” iku cekakan saka apa?
gloss: QR codes are scanned with phones to pay. What does 'QR' stand for? — Quick Response (Denso Wave, 1994).

text: Turnamen tenis Grand Slam endi sing dimainaké ing lapangan lemah abang?
gloss: Which Grand Slam tennis tournament is played on red clay? — The French Open (Roland Garros). Wimbledon is grass, the other two hard courts.

text: Perjanjian taun 1755 sing mbagi Mataram dadi Kasunanan Surakarta lan Kasultanan Ngayogyakarta diarani Perjanjian apa?
gloss: The 1755 treaty that split Mataram into the Surakarta Sunanate and the Yogyakarta Sultanate is the Treaty of… — Giyanti. Salatiga (1757) created Mangkunegaran; Tuntang (1811) and Bongaya (1667) are other colonial-era treaties.

text: Ukara kondhang “amenangi jaman édan” asalé saka serat anggitané R. Ng. Ranggawarsita. Serat apa?
gloss: The famous line 'living through a mad age' comes from a work by Ranggawarsita. Which? — Serat Kalatidha. Wulangrèh is by Pakubuwana IV, Tripama by Mangkunegara IV, Centhini a court compilation.

text: Ing pucuk Gunung Lawu, banyu digodhog nganti umob. Dibandhingaké ing pinggir segara, suhu umobé banyu ing kana kepriyé?
gloss: Water is boiled on the summit of Mount Lawu. Compared with the seashore, its boiling temperature is… — Lower: air pressure is lower up high, so water boils below 100 °C.

text: Papat negara iki padha ana ing pulo sing uga dadi wilayah Indonésia. Endi sing tapel wates dharatané ora gathuk karo Indonésia?
gloss: All four countries share an island with Indonesian territory. Which has no land border with Indonesia? — Brunei: it is on Borneo but surrounded by Malaysian Sarawak.

text: Patung prunggu wong lanang lungguh mikir karo janggut disangga tangan, “Le Penseur”, iku karyané sapa?
gloss: The bronze of a seated man thinking with his chin on his hand, 'The Thinker', is by whom? — Auguste Rodin.

text: Mendoan, gorengan tempé khas Banyumas, jenengé asalé saka tembung Banyumasan “mendo”. Apa tegesé?
gloss: Mendoan, Banyumas fried tempeh, is named after the dialect word 'mendo'. What does it mean? — Half-cooked (soft): mendoan is fried only briefly and stays limp.

text: Kéwan segara endi sing nduwé jantung telu?
gloss: Which sea creature has three hearts? — The octopus. Jellyfish and starfish have no heart at all, a shark has one.

text: Berkas 80 MB diundhuh nganggo internet sing kacepetané ajeg 80 Mbps. Paling cepet butuh wektu pira?
gloss: An 80 MB file is downloaded at a steady 80 Mbps. The fastest it can take? — 8 seconds: MB is megabytes, Mbps megabits per second, and a byte is 8 bits. 1 second is the autopilot trap.

text: Game Tetris, sing baloké tiba lan kudu ditata dadi larikan, pisanan digawé ing negara endi?
gloss: Tetris, the game of falling blocks stacked into rows, was first made in which country? — The Soviet Union (Alexey Pajitnov, Moscow, 1984). Japan is the trap through Nintendo's Game Boy version.

text: Ing pewayangan, sapa ibuné Nakula lan Sadéwa, kembar paling enom ing Pandhawa?
gloss: In wayang, who is the mother of Nakula and Sadéwa, the youngest Pandawa twins? — Dewi Madrim. Kunthi bore the three elder brothers, Gendari the Kurawa; Drupadi is the Pandawa's wife.

text: Prasasti taun 732 Masèhi sing ditemokaké ing Gunung Wukir, Magelang, lan nyebut jeneng Raja Sanjaya, diarani prasasti apa?
gloss: The 732 CE inscription found at Gunung Wukir, Magelang, naming King Sanjaya, is called the… inscription. — Canggal (654 Saka). Kalasan is 778 Central Java, Tugu Tarumanagara, Kedukan Bukit Srivijaya.

text: Kabel listrik umumé nganggo tembaga. Nanging logam endi sing sejatiné nyalurké listrik luwih apik tinimbang tembaga?
gloss: Electric wires are usually copper. Which metal actually conducts electricity better than copper? — Silver, the best conductor of all metals; gold, used on contacts for not corroding, conducts worse than copper.

text: Perjanjian Tordesillas taun 1494 mbagi donya sing lagi ditemokaké dadi rong wilayah. Antarané negara endi waé?
gloss: The 1494 Treaty of Tordesillas split the newly found world into two zones. Between which countries? — Spain and Portugal.

text: Wong Jawa ngarani kréta api “sepur”, saka tembung Walanda “spoor”. Ing basa Walanda, apa tegesé “spoor”?
gloss: Javanese calls the train 'sepur', from Dutch 'spoor'. What does 'spoor' mean in Dutch? — Track/rail (spoorweg = railway); a train is 'trein'.

text: Masjid Istiqlal ing Jakarta dirancang déning arsitèk sing agamané Kristen. Sapa arsitèk iku?
gloss: Jakarta's Istiqlal Mosque was designed by a Christian architect. Who? — Friedrich Silaban, a Batak Protestant, won the 1955 design contest. Soejoedi designed the parliament building, Maclaine Pont the ITB hall, Karsten planned Semarang and Malang.

text: Komponis Prancis endi sing kepincut swara gamelan Jawa ing Pameran Donya Paris 1889, lan pangaruhé katon ing karya-karyané?
gloss: Which French composer was captivated by Javanese gamelan at the 1889 Paris World's Fair, with its influence heard in his works? — Claude Debussy (e.g. 'Pagodes'). Bizet and Berlioz were already dead by 1889.

text: Sapa sing nyipta World Wide Web ing taun 1989 nalika nyambut gawé ing CERN?
gloss: Who invented the World Wide Web in 1989 while working at CERN? — Tim Berners-Lee. Vint Cerf is the trap: he co-designed TCP/IP, the internet underneath.

text: Yogyakarta dumunung ing sisih kidul khatulistiwa. Ing wulan endi wayangané Tugu Yogyakarta tiba ngidul nalika srengéngé ana ing dhuwur dhéwé?
gloss: Yogyakarta lies south of the equator (about 7.8° S). In which month does the Tugu monument's midday shadow fall to the south? — June: the Sun is then over the northern tropic, north of Yogyakarta. From November to January it is south of the city, so the shadow points north.

text: Unsur kimia nomer 92 dijenengi miturut planèt Uranus. Apa jenengé unsur nomer 94?
gloss: Element 92 is named after Uranus. What is element 94 called? — Plutonium: 93 and 94 follow the planets outward, Neptunium then Plutonium. Americium (95) and curium (96) come next.

text: Sengkalan diwaca saka mburi. Taun Saka pira sing dituduhaké sengkalan “Sirna Ilang Kertaning Bumi”?
gloss: A sengkalan (word chronogram) is read backwards. Which Saka year does 'Sirna Ilang Kertaning Bumi' give? — 1400: sirna = 0, ilang = 0, kerta = 4, bumi = 1, read in reverse.
